faq_heading: North Delta Townhomes for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

North Delta townhomes for sale: ground-level homes in strata buildings. The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board benchmark for townhomes in North Delta was $845,600 in September 2026 (-4.7% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
North Delta townhomes sold, November 2025 to October 2026

43 townhomes sold in North Delta with a median price of $805,000 (the middle half sold between $726,000 and $907,500), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $493 per square foot, a median year built of 2009 and a median strata fee of $422 a month.

Over the past year it fell 4.7%; over three months it fell 2.7%; over the last month it was little changed (-0.6%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 12.9%; over 5 years it rose 2.1%.

North Delta: the townhomes benchmark of $845,600 sits $314,000 below the detached houses benchmark of $1,159,600 (73% of it) and $366,600 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $479,000 (177% of it).
Elementary and middle schools in Delta (North Delta, Ladner and Tsawwassen)

It is not a catchment list: which school serves a home is set by address, so check the exact address with the school district.

items.t: North Delta real estate market stats

faq.q: What did townhomes in North Delta sell for?
faq.a: 43 townhomes sold in North Delta between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $805,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in North Delta?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most townhomes in North Delta sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 43 townhomes that sold in North Delta went for between $726,000 and $907,500, around a median of $805,000.

faq.q: Do townhomes in North Delta sell above asking price?
faq.a: 7% of the 43 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.1% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for townhomes in North Delta?
faq.a: Of the 43 sales, 42 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $422.

faq.q: How old are the townhomes that sold in North Delta?
faq.a: The median year built was 2009 for the 43 townhomes sold in North Delta.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do townhomes in North Delta usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in North Delta had 3 bedrooms, from the 43 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which North Delta communities sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Nordel (17), Sunshine Hills Woods (16), Scottsdale (5), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a townhome in North Delta?
faq.a: The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for townhomes in North Delta was $845,600 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did townhome prices fall in North Delta?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 4.7%. Over three months it fell 2.7%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is North Delta a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in North Delta had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in North Delta?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the townhomes in North Delta that match what you want.
